sentences.en: For thy sake, tobacco, I would do anything but die.
sentences.zh: 为了你，烟草，我愿意为你做任何事除了死。

sentences.en: The company has a monopoly on the nation's tobacco business.
sentences.zh: 该公司对该国的烟草业务享有垄断权。

sentences.en: We can smell an odor of tobacco in this bedroom.
sentences.zh: 我们可以在这间卧室里闻到烟草的味道。

senses.zh: 烟草，烟叶,烟草制品,卷烟,纸烟
